newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria will meet 3 pct deficit goal in 1997-Klima.
newsitem.headline: Austria will meet 3 pct deficit goal in 1997-Klima.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima said on Tuesday he believed the country was on target this year to meet the three percent budget deficit critierion for Europe's single currency.
"I believe we will, as expected, meet our budget target in 1997, namely a deficit of a maximum three percent," he told reporters after the weekly cabinet meeting. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
